digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection / verifier path routing
propositions: Three separate code paths that select the verifier model all incorrectly fall back to the default provider when a non-default model is configured, silently breaking downgrade logic across Bedrock and other providers.

Verifier selection uses direct equality tests against DEFAULT_MODEL rather than resolving reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier), making it incompatible with provider-qualified model identifiers.

The code-review gate's verify step declares no model: key and carries temperature: 0 for determinism, but running on the frontier model silently drops that setting, making the configuration ineffective.

Multiple independent verifier call sites (_verifier_cfg, completion path, code-review verify step, xcheck callers at 198/336) must be consolidated under a single resolve_model_string() function to prevent future drift.
Literal model IDs passed as class names must round-trip unchanged through resolution to preserve backward compatibility with existing workflow YAML.
resolve_model() in config.py cannot import model_classes at module level due to circular dependency, requiring lazy function-scope imports at all call sites.
